# Benefit Builder LLC

> Texas-based Section 125 cafeteria plan administrator. We help employers cut FICA payroll tax, raise employee take-home pay, and stay IRS-compliant with bundled plan documents, NDT, and payroll integration.

Founded 2019, family-run, headquartered in Willis, TX. Serves employers and brokers nationwide. All-inclusive monthly fee, no surprise costs.

## What we do

- Section 125 Premium Only Plan (POP) administration
- FICA savings analysis for employers
- Non-discrimination testing (NDT)
- Plan documents, adoption agreements, salary reduction agreements
- Payroll integration and roster sync
- HSA and FSA administration
- Supplemental benefits: life, accident, critical illness, disability, gap
- Broker partnership program
